title: "Add and Manage Vendors"
description: "Add business and service providers to your event as vendors, assign them tasks, and check them in."
icon: "store"
---

Vendors are business or service providers — caterers, photographers, AV companies, florists — that you add to your event alongside your guest list. They get their own view with assigned tasks and event details.

<Frame>
  <img src="/assets/Circle/vendor-management-2.png" alt="Vendor Management screenshot" style={{ borderRadius: "8px" }} />
</Frame>

## What vendors can do

Once added to an event, a vendor can:

- View the event details relevant to their role
- See tasks assigned to them
- Check in at the event through their own view

Vendors do not appear on the guest list and do not go through the RSVP or registration flow.

## Adding a vendor to an event

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open your event">
    Go to the event you want to add a vendor to.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Go to Vendors">
    Open the Vendors section of your event.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Add vendor details">
    Enter the vendor's business name and contact details.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Save">
    The vendor is added to your event.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Assigning tasks to vendors

Tasks can be assigned to vendors just like they can be assigned to co-hosts. When you create or edit a task, select the vendor as the assignee. The vendor sees their assigned tasks in their vendor view.

This is useful for coordinating pre-event delivery, setup, and breakdown responsibilities with your service providers.

## Vendor check-in

On the day of the event, vendors can be checked in through the vendor check-in flow — separate from the guest check-in process. This lets you track which vendors have arrived and are on-site.

## Business profile setup

To receive vendor assignments and access their task list, a vendor needs a business profile set up in Fast Party (via **/business/setup**). Once their profile is active, they can be added to events and access their vendor view.

<Note>
  Vendors access their assigned tasks and check-in through their own dedicated view, separate from the host and guest experience.
</Note>

<Tip>
  Use vendor task assignment to send briefings, delivery instructions, and setup requirements directly through Fast Party — keeping all event coordination in one place.
</Tip>
